limitations: Only two robots and the near/rear short task are evaluated.
Second training seed has alignment development evaluation only, not a full transport test.
The curriculum progression rule is common; attained stages differ between rewards.
Robot-to-robot contacts occur during pushing; body-to-cargo contacts and falls were absent in these 120 cases.
Two-core local timing is not a measurement of Google-hosted Colab.
